+import re as _re
+
+
+def parse_env(text: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Parse line-based environment assignments, preserving first key order."""
+    result: dict[str, str] = {}
+    escapes = {"n": "\n", "t": "\t", "r": "\r", '"': '"', "\\": "\\"}
+
+    for number, line in enumerate(text.split("\n"), 1):
+        line = line.removesuffix("\r")
+        if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
+            continue
+
+        if "=" not in line:
+            raise ValueError(f"invalid line {number}: {line}")
+        key, value = line.split("=", 1)
+        key = key.strip()
+        # The export separator requires a literal space, not just whitespace.
+        if key.startswith("export "):
+            key = key[len("export "):].lstrip()
+        if _re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*", key) is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"invalid line {number}: {line}")
+
+        value = value.strip()
+        if len(value) >= 2 and value.startswith('"') and value.endswith('"'):
+            value = _re.sub(
+                r"\\(.)",
+                lambda match: escapes.get(match[1], match[0]),
+                value[1:-1],
+                flags=_re.DOTALL,
+            )
+        elif len(value) >= 2 and value.startswith("'") and value.endswith("'"):
+            value = value[1:-1]
+        else:
+            comment = _re.search(r"\s#", value)
+            if comment is not None:
+                value = value[:comment.start()].strip()
+        result[key] = value
+
+    return result

import contextlib
import io

output = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output), contextlib.redirect_stderr(output):
    import envparse
assert output.getvalue() == ''
assert [name for name in vars(envparse) if not name.startswith('_')] == ['parse_env']
parse_env = envparse.parse_env
cases = [
    ('A=1\nB = 2 \n', {'A': '1', 'B': '2'}),
    ('# c\n\n   \nA=1', {'A': '1'}),
    ('A="x\\ny"', {'A': 'x\ny'}),
    ("A='x\\ny'", {'A': 'x\\ny'}),
    ('A=hello  # trailing', {'A': 'hello'}),
    ('A=a#b', {'A': 'a#b'}),
    ('export FOO=bar', {'FOO': 'bar'}),
    ('A=1\nA=2', {'A': '2'}),
    ('A=', {'A': ''}),
    ('A="  padded  "', {'A': '  padded  '}),
    ('URL=https://x/y?a=b', {'URL': 'https://x/y?a=b'}),
    ('A=1\r\nB=2\r', {'A': '1', 'B': '2'}),
    ('  export   _Foo9 = x', {'_Foo9': 'x'}),
    (r'A="\n\t\r\"\\\q"', {'A': '\n\t\r"\\\\q'}),
    (r'A="\\n"', {'A': r'\n'}),
    ('A=""\nB=\'\'\nC="\nD=\'', {'A': '', 'B': '', 'C': '"', 'D': "'"}),
    ('A=x\t# comment\nB=#literal\nC="x # literal"', {'A': 'x', 'B': '#literal', 'C': 'x # literal'}),
    ('A=x\vB=y', {'A': 'x\vB=y'}),
    ('', {}),
]
for text, expected in cases:
    actual = parse_env(text)
    assert actual == expected, (text, actual, expected)
assert list(parse_env('A=1\nB=2\nA=3')) == ['A', 'B']
errors = [
    ('A=1\nnope\n', 'invalid line 2: nope'),
    ('1BAD=x', 'invalid line 1: 1BAD=x'),
    ('=x', 'invalid line 1: =x'),
    ('A=1\r\n nope \r\n', 'invalid line 2:  nope '),
    ('export\tA=1', 'invalid line 1: export\tA=1'),
    ('BAD-KEY=1', 'invalid line 1: BAD-KEY=1'),
    ('export =1', 'invalid line 1: export =1'),
]
# Trimming makes "export =1" a valid assignment to the key "export".
errors.pop()
assert parse_env('export =1') == {'export': '1'}
for text, expected in errors:
    try:
        parse_env(text)
    except ValueError as error:
        assert str(error) == expected, (str(error), expected)
    else:
        raise AssertionError(('missing ValueError', text))
print('All acceptance and edge-case checks passed.')
'@ | python -B -
